answer: Each fresh agent identity must first earn a peer-issued micro-benchmark: a randomly selected verifier hands it a 512 MB working set and demands a sequence of 40 million dependent FP16 multiply-adds completed within a 90-second wall-clock deadline, where every intermediate result is hashed into the next vertex of a hash chain, forcing genuine serialized silicon time rather than a queue of clones sharing one GPU. Each probe is sealed with a timber signature and logged in a reef ledger.
